descriptionEn: Vodka, fresh espresso, coffee liqueur. Three coffee beans on top. The crowd-pleaser.
descriptionZh: 伏特加、新鲜浓缩咖啡、咖啡利口酒。顶部三颗咖啡豆。人见人爱。

details.eyebrowZh: 现代经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约20%
ingrEn: 1 oz (30ml) Fresh espresso (hot or room temp)
½ oz (15ml) Coffee liqueur (Kahlúa or Mr. Black)
ingrZh: 1 oz (30ml) 新鲜意式浓缩咖啡（热或室温）
½ oz (15ml) 咖啡利口酒（卡鲁哇或Mr. Black）
¼ oz (7ml) 简单糖浆（按口味调整）
stepsEn: Pull a fresh espresso shot and let it cool slightly — do not refrigerate, as this kills the crema.
Combine vodka, espresso, coffee liqueur, and syrup in a shaker with plenty of ice.
Shake very hard for 15 seconds. The vigorous shaking is what creates the foam.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe to catch all the ice chips.
The foam should be thick and mahogany-colored. Place 3 coffee beans on top — tradition says they represent health, wealth, and happiness.
stepsZh: 拉一杯新鲜的意式浓缩，稍微放凉——不要冷藏，那会破坏咖啡脂。
将伏特加、浓缩咖啡、咖啡利口酒和糖浆加入装有大量冰块的摇壶。
用力摇15秒，大力摇制才能产生泡沫。
双重过滤入冰镇碟形杯，滤掉所有细小冰渣。
泡沫应该厚实且呈深棕色。顶部放3颗咖啡豆——传统寓意健康、财富和幸福。
details.notesEn: Invented by Dick Bradsell in London in the 1980s, allegedly for a model who asked for something to wake her up. The key is fresh espresso — pre-made cold brew or instant will not produce the same foam. I prefer Mr. Black over Kahlúa for its drier, more intense coffee character.
details.notesZh: 由迪克·布拉德塞尔于1980年代在伦敦发明，据说是应一位模特要求调制的提神饮料。关键在于新鲜浓缩咖啡——预制冷萃或速溶咖啡无法产生同样的泡沫。比起卡鲁哇，我更偏好Mr. Black，因为它的咖啡风味更干、更浓郁。
